name: I Am Zombie VR
summary:
I Am Zombie VR is a fast-paced VR action game where you become the zombie.

Enter a dangerous laboratory outbreak and hunt down terrified humans from a first-person perspective. Use your hands to grab, chase, and infect your targets as chaos spreads through a stylized sci-fi lab. Every moment is built for immersive VR gameplay—feel the tension as victims run, panic, and try to escape.
